newsitem.title: FRANCE: Daewoo disappointed by Thomson decision.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo disappointed by Thomson decision.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Electronics said in a statement it was "surprised and disappointed" about the French government's decision to suspend the sale of Thomson SA to it and Lagardere Groupe.
"We have learned that the privatisation process of Thomson has been suspended following the opinion given by the Commission on Privatisation," Daewoo said.
"Although we do not yet know the details of the Commission's opinion, we are disappointed and surprised by this decision given the French government's preference for our offer.

"We regret that our project, which would allow TMM (Thomson Multimedia) to be a world leader, has not been fully conveyed. We nonetheless believe that the partnership of our two groups is the one most likely to lead to a lasting turn around, a strategy of growth, as well as of maintenance and the creation of jobs in France," Daewoo said.
